title: When I load an `external` script by setting its `resource_path`, the code is only updated after I restart the game.
body: ### Tested versions 4.5.2 ## System information Windows 11 ## Issue description When I load an **external** script (not being in the `res://` folder) which is frequently changed, his code isn't updated until I start the game again. But if his `resource_path` is not set, the script is reloaded every time it is loaded. But with his `resource_path` undefined, the script is always reloaded. ## Steps to reproduce In an external folder, I have a script called `Combo.gd`, and this script extends `data/ComboData.gd`. If I use the `load` and `ResourceLoader.load` functions to, or manually set the `resource_path`, load the `Combo.gd` script, it extends the script normally, because these functions automatically sets `resouce_path`. However, if the resource_path is empty, it doesn't work because it needs to be set to know the script's location, but also the script is always reloaded. ### Functions that prevent the script from being reloaded: Using `load` method: ```gdscript func load_external_script(path_absolute: String) -> GDScript: return load(path_absolute) ``` Using `ResourceLoader`: ```gdscript func load_external_script(path: String): return ResourceLoader.load(path, ResouceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) ``` Set the `resource_path` manually: ```gdscript func load_external_script(path_absolute: String) -> GDScript: var script: GDScript = GDScript.new() script.resouce_path = path_absolute script.source_code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path_absolute) script.reload() return script ``` ### The only way to make it work is by creating the script manually, but without defining his `resouce_path`: ```gdscript func load_external_script(path_absolute: String) -> GDScript: var script: GDScript = GDScript.new() # script.resouce_path = path_absolute script.source_code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path_absolute) script.reload() return script ``` But without setting its resource_path. But as I mentioned before, without the resource_path, it's not possible to extend scripts from the same folder.
